name: Hyperreal (indistinguishable from camera footage)
description: Anything that must pass as real modern footage: influencers talking to camera, lifestyle scenes, testimonials, cinematic live action.
look: An unretouched frame from real footage shot on a modern full-frame cinema camera: natural skin texture with pores, peach fuzz and small imperfections, real hair flyaways, accurate color, motivated natural light with soft falloff, subtle lens character, true-to-life proportions. Real people in real places.
imageRules: Skin is never airbrushed; eyes have natural catchlights and slight asymmetry; hands have five fingers with real knuckles; clothing has wrinkles and real fabric weight; backgrounds are real lived-in places.
negative: AI sheen, plastic or waxy skin, airbrushing, perfect symmetry, HDR, over-saturation, glowing edges, stock-photo posing, 3D render, extra fingers, warped text, collage
camera: Real camera behaviour: 24-85mm, eye level, motivated moves only (slow push, handheld micro-drift for intimacy). Shallow-to-moderate depth of field like a real lens. Talking heads: eye-line into or just off the lens, chest-up framing.
motion: Natural human micro-motion: breathing, small head tilts, blinks, real weight shifts. Hands move with purpose. No floaty or slow-motion feel. Keep exact skin and fabric texture from the first frame.

characterSheet.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four unretouched candid photographs of the same {who}, all taken in {set} in the same natural light: top-left head-and-shoulders facing camera, top-right three-quarter view, bottom-left side profile, bottom-right full body. {look}. Identical face, hair, body and wardrobe in all four. Thin white gutters between panels. No text, no labels.

frame.realism: Passes as an unedited photo: real skin texture, natural light, correct hands, no AI sheen.

clip.realism: Passes as real footage: natural micro-motion, no waxy skin, no warping hands, believable lip-sync.

launch.note: real footage already matches a photoreal world
